title: Prove and attain the scoped 94-helper P104 three-target bound
head: a0030819c6d0e89e133cd3e52cc748035d58e3c7
body:
PR2445 asks whether a third named P104 target can share source acquisitions while retaining enough independent collectors at compatible frames. This package answers that question for **Y0/Y1/Y2 in an explicitly restricted incidence-separated architecture**: 90 source acquisitions require four additional source-independent dirty collectors, and an exact 94-helper word attains the bound.

The collector deficit is new: groups {0,2}, {1,2}, and {0,1,2} have coefficient rank one but need two, two, and three independent designated collector rows. If R has q independent collector rows and acquisition input map [D;0] has codimension k, `rank(R[D;0]) >= q-k` proves k >= q-r. The certificate supplies all seven group ranks, frames, source supports and a literal restored word.

**The 94 minimum is only for the stated initial-line, one-capture, incidence-separated simultaneous collector architecture.** It is not an unrestricted relay minimum or physical stock bound. The audit also finds twelve Y2-exclusive sources whose first expanded frame remains inside H2, so the Y0/Y1 escape proof does not establish a 90-source unrestricted lower bound. That concrete exception is an open construction route.

The full partial channel has 4,877 events and 374 arbitrary input columns. Y0/Y1/Y2 finish as identity transfers; other 101 targets retain G/2. All original and added dirty helper inputs restore. Added local bill: 532 ADDs, 287 nested transports, profile `149 H1 + 37 H2 + 7 H3 + 8 H5 + 40 H6 + 46 H7`, and 846 ZERO-to-FULL boundary rank units. Boundary progress is not recursive excess cost.

Validation, standard-library CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/p104-third-target-collector-rank/verify.py --regenerate
python3.12 -I -O -B research/p104-third-target-collector-rank/independent.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-third-target-collector-rank
```

Sparse Fraction and separately implemented dense dyadic/echelon checkers compare all 139,876 endpoint coefficients. Ten primary and three independent semantic faults reject; positive baseline/equivalent-frame checks and full literal regeneration pass. Exact source pins, task scope and open next questions are included. Hosted CI is separate.

No complete supplier or new kappa. Native transport phases/scalar-address lowering, reverse supplier orientation, global owners and idle/residual children, physical precision/tape, all-size admission and the remaining 101 corrections are unrun. The selected record and frozen source files are unchanged.

Credit Ross Richardson / PR2445 (head `6def43ad673b91dbd491389964d1dcd059bf2ac2`) for the two-target construction, two-total shear and third-target handoff; commdata2338 / PR2393, Hiroki Kumazaki / PR2353, Philippe Van Velzen, Rohan Arun / PR1972, Chafik Boukhalfa / PR1991, Adam Gall / PR1940, Josie Elliston / PR1071, Ali Romman / PR1125 and the retained lineage. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, code, checking and writing. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
